clips.title: The story
paras: At Alther's Mill, Lucius tests Alliance rogues with a locked chest and thieves' tools. The mill lies northeast along the road from Lakeshire, where Blackrock orcs now draw near.

Lucius sends you northeast along the road from Lakeshire to Alther's Mill, with your first set of thieves' tools. There, you face a locked chest and a test of skill. Open Lucius's personal lockbox and bring back the token inside to earn your Certificate of Thievery.

Alther's Mill once served as a lumber outpost, but Blackrock orcs now encroach on Redridge and have drawn near. Lucius treats their presence as an added trial. SI:7 expects its agents to pick locks undetected while moving through enemy-held territory.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We've been training thieves here for years! After all, not every rapscallion is born with the grace and finesse of old Lucius.
Up off the road here you'll find Alther's Mill. I got a chest up there with something important inside. Go get it for me! Bring back that token and you'll receive your Certificate of Thievery!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did I forget to mention the orcs?
I hear they have been nosing around up by the mill.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Cracked it open, did you? Nice work, friend.
If you die now, we can rest easy knowing it was due to your own stupidity and not inexperience.
